items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Well that time Big Al Lewis was playing with Mania, you see.

ctx.x: Say, did the Golden Rule Band and the Imperial and Buddy Bolden's bands, and- It was the same at the same time.

Did they sound alike at all, the bands, or would they sound different? Well I'm going to tell you, Mania had what you call a swing band. A swing band? Yeah. And Buddy Bolden had a blues band, more of the blues, you see. It was at a contest at the Globe's Hall one time. Mania and the Buddy Bolden Band. Well that time Big Al Lewis was playing with Mania, you see. And first do you know Buddy Bolden Sharp.
